summary: The comment urges schools to be transparent with parents about online content that encourages gender transition and to provide parents with access to review such material.

claims.requested_action: require schools to disclose and allow parent review of online content related to gender transition
claims.argument: Parents must be able to see and evaluate any online material that encourages gender transition or medical interventions for minors.
